visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a slow camera pan across a kitchen counter filled with various prepared dishes. The setting is a brightly lit indoor kitchen with white countertops and wooden cutting boards. Food items include a salad bowl, a carved pumpkin, and peculiar pastry-and-pretzel snacks arranged on wooden boards. (2) A person's hand enters the frame and picks up a snack resembling a witch's broom, crafted from puff pastry and a pretzel stick, resting atop sesame-seeded bread rings. (3) The camera focuses on 'spider' muffins, which are chocolate-colored muffins decorated with pretzel stick legs and edible round eyes. (4) A close-up shows the hand using a metal punch and a yellow plastic press tool to cut small circular eyes out of a slice of yellow cheese. (5) The shot transitions to apple slices stuffed with mini marshmallows to look like teeth, followed by the hand holding a bag of Trader Joe's Mini Maple Flavored Marshmallows. (6) A meat dish in a red fluted pan is shown, topped with overlapping pastry strips and marshmallow 'teeth' to create a mummy face. (7) Deviled eggs are presented, filled with green avocado mash and a single black olive slice to mimic eyeballs. (8) The hand lifts the lid off a small, roasted, carved pumpkin, revealing a savory beef filling inside. (9) Finally, a hand picks up a ghost-shaped potato chip from a bowl and displays a bag of Trader Joe's Ghosts & Bats Crispy Potato Snacks.
